title: Quickzy
shortDescription: A high-performance full-stack MERN e-commerce application featuring optimistic UI cart updates, atomic inventory management, faceted filtering, and secure JWT authentication.
overview: Quickzy is an enterprise-grade full-stack MERN e-commerce web platform engineered for sub-second catalog interactions and zero-lag shopping cart workflows. Designed with React, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, Quickzy delivers instant client-side cart updates with server reconciliation, atomic database increments to prevent inventory overselling, and responsive faceted search across high-volume product catalogs.
problem: High-traffic e-commerce experiences often suffer from sluggish cart mutations caused by blocking server roundtrips, alongside race conditions during peak flash sales that lead to overselling and negative inventory states.
solution: Architected an optimistic UI state machine with Redux Toolkit that reflects cart updates in 0ms while asynchronously syncing with Node.js/Express REST APIs, paired with atomic MongoDB $inc operations with stock threshold constraints to guarantee zero inventory anomalies.

features.title: Optimistic UI Cart Engine
features.description: Zero-latency shopping cart mutations powered by Redux Toolkit with automatic server rollback on network failure.

features.title: Atomic Inventory Management
features.description: Race-condition-free stock reservations using atomic Mongoose conditional updates during concurrent checkout bursts.

features.title: Faceted Catalog Search
features.description: Debounced multi-attribute search across categories, price brackets, and ratings with sub-25ms response times.

features.title: Role-Based Admin Dashboard
features.description: Administrative suite for live stock tracking, SKU adjustments, order lifecycle statuses, and inventory threshold warnings.

contributions: Architected end-to-end MERN stack application with clean separation of frontend components, REST controllers, and database models.
Engineered optimistic state management in Redux Toolkit for seamless cart additions, removals, and quantity modifications.
Implemented atomic MongoDB update queries to prevent overselling during simultaneous multi-user checkout sessions.
Designed and built full responsive UI with Tailwind CSS, slide-over cart drawers, and administrative product controls.

challenges.title: Eliminating Race Conditions in Flash Sale Checkouts
challenges.challenge: Concurrent checkout requests for low-stock items could read stale inventory values and result in overselling.
challenges.solution: Replaced standard read-then-write logic with atomic Product.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: id, stock: { $gte: qty } }, { $inc: { stock: -qty } }) queries ensuring strict database-level concurrency control.

challenges.title: Cart Latency and Offline Resilience
challenges.challenge: Network latency caused noticeable delays between clicking 'Add to Cart' and user feedback, causing repeated clicks.
challenges.solution: Implemented an optimistic mutation layer with Redux Toolkit that updates local state immediately, syncing with the backend in the background and gracefully rolling back if the request fails.
